status: Exploratory elaboration of frozen observable-moderator scope, after weighted headline results observed; not preregistered.
design: For each supported baseline country/cohort cell, split at the median pre-event GDP per capita among all observed market-data countries with GDPpc. Apply same threshold to both arms. Equal-country and constant-GDP weighting, three outcomes, all families/benchmark, at least3 controls per subgroup/cohort. No p-values. Median is selected without outcome changes. Publish unsupported groups.
